correctness.rationale: Start edge 2 vertices, each attachment samples uniform vertex then uniform neighbor; stars have probability s_n=2/(n-1). For n>=4 diameter<=3 precisely J_n<=2 with all nonleaf vertices adjacent. Mark second internal vertex and b of its leaf neighbors. The exact surviving-double-star recurrence is q_{n+1}(b)=[n-2-b+1/(b+1)]q_n(b)/n+[b-1+1/(n-b)]q_n(b-1)/n+2*1_{b=1}/[n(n-1)]. It has correct star-to-two-hub birth and kills trajectories producing a third internal vertex. Stable n*q_n(b) limit yields c_1=4/3, c_b=4/[b(b+2)] at each fixed b. Fractional moment F_n=sum b^(1/8)q_n(b) has drift bound F_{n+1}<=(1-17/(16n))F_n+2/[n(n-1)], leading F_n<=64/n, so no mass escapes to b→infinity, and summation gives total 3. Star contribution 2 yields nP(diam<=3)→5, with conditional mass 4/[3b(b+2)]. Independent rational history enumeration through n=8 is encoded in checker, and an independent n=1800 recurrence calculation gave nP(J=2)~3.01543 and nP(diam<=3)~5.01654. Infinite asymptotics rely on tightness and stable-recursion proof.
